chapter: The Attack of the... Purple Tepetlisaurus?
act_title: The Attack of the... Purple Tepetlisaurus?

quests.title: The Attack of the... Purple Tepetlisaurus?

dialogue.t: Hey! You, yeah, I'm talking to you! It's dangerous out there, get inside, quick!
Haven't you seen the mess along the way? There's been a volcanic eruption, and there are monsters blocking the road. You shouldn't go any further.
Listen to me. Stay here for a bit and wait. In a while, you can head out with the rest of our caravan. That way, we can watch each other's backs. Otherwise, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
Yeah, a whole pack of purple Tepetlisaurs! They've clearly been corrupted by the Abyss! Insanely destructive. Honestly, I've never seen any of their kind this terrifying before!
Let me tell you, those things casually swung their tails and completely wrecked our carts. They're even stronger than Tatankasaurs — definitely not the kind of opponents just anyone can handle.
I'm serious — don't get all hot-headed and try to fight them. If you see them, just steer clear, alright?

dialogue.sit: (It blinks, as if to thank you.)

dialogue.t: Th—Thank you...
Ugh... Ow, ow...
*panting*
I—I'm okay, just got a bit flustered from running earlier. Need a moment to catch my breath...
Hey, you over there! St—Stop! This stuff is ours! Hands off! I'm warning you...! I—I could totally qualify for the Night Warden Wars!
You try taking our things, and I'll... I'll show you what for!
*sigh*... What's going on today? First a volcanic eruption, then a purple Tepetlisaurus... and now a bunch of bandits? What rotten luck...
Masose, he(she) looks pretty tough. I don't think we can take him(her). Besides, we're just here to watch the competition, not get involved...
H—How can you say that, Itsaho? This is OUR stuff! And anyway, it's two against one here. We might actually stand a chance!
Where are you getting that "two" from? If anyone's getting beaten up, it's just you. Don't drag me into this...
Uh, hey, sir(ma'am), we don't want the stuff anymore. If you want it, just take it. Just don't hurt us, okay?

dialogue.sit: This has to be a misunderstanding...
Hmm, quite the bright spark, aren't you?

dialogue.t: You've got it all wrong! We're actually helpful adventurers, not some random villains!
And why should I believe yo— Ow! The heck did you hit me for, Itsaho!?
If they were up to no good, they'd have already beaten you up. Why would they even waste time talking to us?

To be honest with you both, our caravan got scattered not long ago. If it's not too much trouble, could you help us pass a message to our boss? Just let her know we're waiting for her here — we'd really appreciate it.
You can take the things in the box — consider them our token of thanks.
Oh, that's easy enough. Leave it to us!
Oh no, Itsaho, there's still so much missing from the list... H—Help me look for them, would you?
*sigh*... Don't waste your time. I already checked. Most of them were fragile goods. Do you really think any of them are still in one piece after the eruption and the crash?
Save your energy and take a break. We've got a long road ahead of us once the boss and the others get back.
N—No way! F—Fine, if you're not going, I'll just go myself...
What am I gonna do... What am I gonna do? The boss is definitely gonna beat me up when I get back...

dialogue.sit: If it were me, I'd just run...

dialogue.t: *sigh* It's a long story... Our caravan was moving along just fine when the volcano erupted out of nowhere. Then, these massive purple Tepetlisaurs burst out of the ground...

I wasn't paying attention, and my saurian partner got spooked and carried me far from the group. By the time I got us turned back around, the path was completely blocked, and now I can't get back to the others...
I don't even know how everyone else is doing... and I ditched the group without permission... The boss is gonna kill me. I'm done. This is it. I'm dead.
So, it's all thanks to these three that you made it out safe, boss?
Haha, that's right! You should've seen them in action — took down those monsters in just a couple of moves!
You saved the caravan leader. That's a debt I haven't much to offer in repayment for. But please, take this small gift as a token of my gratitude.
Seriously, Tizlo? Have you always been this stingy? That's all you're giving to the people who saved your life!?
Phew... what a mess to deal with. To think that I almost got knocked flat by some Tepetlisaurs... That just boils my blood!

dialogue.sit: You've got it all wrong — those are Abyssal monsters! They're way more dangerous than Tepetlisaurs. So you thought they were just ordinary ones... No wonder you struggled!

dialogue.t: Hah, is that it? Makes sense now. I really owe you this time. If it weren't for you guys, I'd have been done for.
Hold on a sec, I need to go round up those useless idiots first. I'll thank you properly once I make sure they're all safe.

dialogue.sit: With your help, the people from the caravan gradually gather around.

dialogue.t: Hey, chubby! Ensuring the caravan's safety is your job, isn't it? So what's this about someone else having to clean up your mess? What do you have to say for yourself?
I—
Quit stuttering! If you hadn't panicked and dropped your guard, a few measly monsters wouldn't have been a problem for me! This time, you're giving up part of your pay to thank our savior. Got it?
I—I... I'll do whatever you say, boss...
Of course, such a small token as a life-saving gift does seem a bit stingy, doesn't it?

dialogue.sit: Indeed, it feels a bit lacking.
No, this is more than enough.

dialogue.t: Haha, well said! I like people like you — you say it how it is!

Ahem, anyway, this is a personal gift from me to you. Just accept it! Consider it a little something extra for your little Tepetlisaurus to get some more snacks. No need for any thanks or formalities!
Rawr!
Alright, we still need to go pick up all the stuff we lost along the way. We'll be heading off now! May we meet again!

quests.description: A merchant caravan seems to have met with some mishap on the path to the volcano…
